_note: Applicant answers used to fill every application. Filled by job-setup. Only the user decides legal/EEO answers.

work_authorization.answer_rules: How to answer each wording, in the user's own words. e.g. 'legally authorized' -> Yes; 'authorized for any employer' -> Yes/No; 'unrestricted authorization' -> Yes/No; 'require sponsorship now or in future' -> Yes/No.

job_preferences.desired_salary_rule: Text field: the number; range dropdowns: the bracket that contains/starts at this number.

education.graduation_year_policy: Only fill when the form requires it.

standard_answers.conflict_of_interest_default: Ask the user the first time a conflict-of-interest question appears; record the answer here.

tailoring._levels: low = headline/summary/skills + max 4 bullets changed; medium = up to 12 bullets reworded; high = everything rewritten around the JD (still only true facts)

consent_policy._help: ask = the form filler leaves the box for you. preauthorized = it ticks the box for you and reports it (only set this if you consent for every application). legal_attestations covers NDA / arbitration / I-certify boxes.
